text: BAM share rose 1.05 percentage points over the last 25 hours and 0.95 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 33.8% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The current leadership pattern should be read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
